items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: I used to play with, uh, Isaiah Morgan's band.

ctx.x: you ever hear Jim Robinson playing from when you were young? Yeah. Sure. I used to play with, uh,

Isaiah Morgan's band. Young Sam Morgan. Yeah. And Jim used to give me lots of work. He used to work on the riverfront, I think. Yeah. And his band would go out of town, especially in the wintertime when I'd just come in there off the show or something like that. Well, he'd work with his band. Isaiah Morgan. Not Sam. Isaiah. Yeah.
